title: Can Occupational Therapy help my child who overreacts to touch or tactile input?
metaTitle: Tactile Sensitivity Management with Occupational Therapy - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Combat tactile sensitivity in children with autism using specialized Occupational Therapy services at Pinnacle Blooms Network. We support your child in understanding and responding to different textures and stimuli.
html: Absolutely. At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand that children with autism, may, often, have tactile sensitivity, leading to overreaction to touch. Our seasoned occupational therapists use their expertise in desensitization techniques and sensory integration therapy to help your child progressively adapt to different textures and stimuli they experience. The goal is to enhance comfort and reduce any associated anxiety or fear.
